jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Job Summary: The Senior Project Manager will be a key contributor to the Test Technology and Systems (TTS) PMO, responsible for independently managing a portfolio of complex and strategic engineering projects for the Quality, Optimization and Excellence Team (QOET). This role involves close collaboration with QOET Engineering Leads and cross-functional teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, risks are mitigated, and objectives are met. The Senior PM will play a crucial role in driving accountability and providing clear project status updates.

Key Responsibilities:
- Independently manage a distinct category or portfolio of complex or strategic QOET projects, collaborating closely with Engineering Leads and relevant functional teams.

- Facilitate detailed project planning sessions, define scope, objectives, success metrics, and resource needs for assigned projects.

- Monitor overall project progress against plans, identify deviations, and proactively work with Engineering Leads to implement corrective actions.

- Ensure rigorous adherence to TTS PMO processes, standards, and templates across their projects.

- Proactively identify, track, and manage significant project risks and issues, escalating critical items to the PMO Lead or Lead PM.

- Drive accountability from QOET Engineering Leads and project team members for project deliverables and milestones.

- Lead the resolution of project roadblocks and delays, engaging cross-functional stakeholders (IT, Manufacturing, Planning) as needed.

- Prepare and deliver accurate and timely project status reports and updates for assigned projects to the PMO Lead and relevant stakeholders.

- Collaborate with Engineering Leads/DRIs on project communications.

- Provide clear and concise updates, seeking guidance from the PMO Lead and Lead PM for high-impact decisions or complex conflicts.

- Provide guidance and support to junior PMs on best practices and problem-solving.

- Champion the use of PMO templates and tools within their assigned projects.

- Provide feedback for process and tool refinement.

Qualifications:
- Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related field.

- Experience:
- Minimum of 5 years of proven project management experience, preferably within a manufacturing or engineering environment.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple projects simultaneously.

- Experience in risk management, issue resolution, and stakeholder management.

- Skills:
- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and collaborating effectively.

- Solid understanding of project management methodologies and tools.

- Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with attention to detail.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and project management software.

- Familiarity with Power BI for reporting and analysis is a plus.

- Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a dynamic environment.

- Effective interpersonal skills, able to build strong working relationships.

- PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification preferred.

About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

ADI’s Aerospace and Defense business unit develops a wide variety of multi-function modules, including frequency synthesizers, phased array beamformers, amplifiers, transmit/receive modules, frequency converters, and proximity sensors. These products are designed using a combination of SMT and hybrid construction technologies and operate across frequency ranges through millimeter-wave.

The Associate Program Manager is responsible for managing program activities across new product development, transition to production, and/or production execution. This role partners closely with Contracts, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality to drive program execution. The position requires strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to operate independently within defined program scope.

Responsibilities:
- Own coordination and assist senior team with execution of program activities across: - New Product Development (NPD)
- Low Rate Initial Production (LRIP) preparation
- Manufacturing handoff and production ramp
- Production execution and performance monitoring

- Develop and maintain detailed program schedules, track execution progress, and manage risks and issues.
- Serve as a primary point of contact for cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Operations, and internal partners; support customer interactions as needed.
- Drive cross-functional team alignment, ensuring clear roles, accountability, and timely delivery of program milestones.
- Monitor program financials, including cost tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis.
- Communicate program status, risks, and key metrics through regular reporting and presentations to internal stakeholders.
- Support customer communications, including status updates and issue resolution.
- Facilitate internal meetings (e.g., Engineering/Manufacturing reviews) to improve execution efficiency and program outcomes
- Ensure adherence to program schedules, cost targets, and quality expectations.

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree in engineering, business management, or related technical field.
- 2+ years of program/project management experience in an engineering or technical development environment.
- Foundational knowledge of program management principles, including scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
- Experience supporting financial tracking and procurement activities.
- Ability to communicate effectively across functional teams and contribute to customer-facing discussions.
- Experience preparing and delivering presentations to internal stakeholders.
- US Citizenship required; ability to obtain a Secret Clearance.

募集要項
Job Title: Customer Operations Manager （カスタマーオペレーション・マネージャー）
勤務地 : 東京

Position Summary （職務概要）
Customer Operations Manager は、顧客アカウントサポート、受注管理、需要調整、ならびに売上創出を支える  Customer Operations チームを率い、組織としての実行力と成果創出を最大化するポジションです。
本ポジションは、高い顧客満足度とオペレーションの卓越性を両立させながら、 Sales および部門横断チーム、さらにはグローバルステークホルダーと主体的に連携し、継続的な改善と測定可能なビジネス成果を推進します。
理想的な候補者は、人材育成に強みを持つリーダーであり、曖昧で変化の多い環境下においても自らオーナーシップを持って判断・調整・実行を行い、顧客および商業的ニーズをスピード感をもって具体的な成果へとつなげられる方です。

Key Responsibilities （主な職務内容）
1. People Leadership & Team Management
- Customer Operations チームをリードし、コーチングと育成を通じて高いパフォーマンスと継続的なスキル向上を実現する
- 迅速性・正確性・持続可能性のバランスを考慮し、業務の割り当て・優先順位付けを行う
- パフォーマンスレビューを通じて建設的なフィードバックを提供し、メンバーのキャリア成長を支援する
- ベストプラクティスおよび業務標準を確立し、成果と顧客価値を重視するチームカルチャーを醸成する

2. Customer Operations Oversight
- 顧客からの問い合わせに対し、迅速・正確かつプロフェッショナルな対応を担保する
- 需要情報の正確な把握、受注入力、社内システム上での受注管理および維持を統括する
- 供給不足や納期リスクを早期に特定し、関連部門を巻き込みながら解決を主導する
- 納期コミットメント、価格、顧客課題に関するエスカレーション対応および意思決定をリードする

3. Business & Revenue Enablement
- Sales と密接に連携し、信頼されるオペレーションおよび分析面でのパートナーとして機能する
- 需要予測の整合、価格施策の実行、業務プロセス最適化を通じて売上成長を支援する
- 社内外のビジネスレビューに参加し、顧客およびオペレーション視点からの示唆・提言を行う
- データ分析を活用し、トレンド、リスク、機会を可視化し、商業的意思決定につなげる

4. Cross Functional & Global Collaboration
- Supply Chain 、 Pricing 、 Finance 等の社内部門と密に連携し、戦略から実行まで一貫したオペレーションを推進する
- グローバルステークホルダーと主体的に協働し、地域・組織を越えた課題に対してオーナーシップを持って調整・合意形成・実行をリードする
- 時差や文化、役割の違いを踏まえた実務的かつ明確なコミュニケーションにより、スピード感のある意思決定と成果創出を実現する
- ローカル顧客ニーズとグローバルプロセス／ポリシーの整合を図り、必要に応じて改善提案やエスカレーションを行う

Requirements （必須要件）
- 学士号（専攻分野不問）
- 日本語・英語ともにビジネスレベルの読み書き・会話能力
- 高い分析力およびコミュニケーション力を有し、部門横断・グローバル環境で影響力を発揮できること
- Microsoft Excel および  PowerPoint における高度なスキル
- 変化が速く多面的な業務環境において、複数の優先事項を管理できる能力
- 曖昧な状況下においても、自ら判断し、実行までやり切り、成果を出した実績

Note
本ポジションは、日本で有効な就労ビザを既に保有している方に限定されます。
当社ではビザ取得・スポンサーシップの提供は行っておりません。

Preferred Skills and Experience （歓迎要件）
- Customer Operations 、 Sales Operations 、 Supply Chain 等の分野でのチームマネジメントまたはリーダー経験
- 複雑な顧客課題に対し、判断力と部門横断調整をもって対応した経験
- 日本語能力： JLPT N1 相当

- グローバルな環境で、課題設定から実行までを主体的にリードした経験

Application Requirements （応募書類）

jobs.description:
About Analog Devices
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com  and on LinkedIn and X .

Production Manager –   Wafer   Fab Operations

The Camas Wafer Fab is a growing   150mm , high-volume, 24/7 semiconductor manufacturing facility producing leading-edge precision integrated circuits that support Analog Devices' diverse portfolio of semiconductor solutions.

The   Production Manager   is responsible for   leading daily manufacturing execution across assigned production shifts within the wafer fabrication facility. This role directly manages a team of Production Supervisors and indirectly leads   approximately   1 20   -   150   Operators, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality manufacturing operations.

The Production Manager plays a critical role in achieving site   objectives   related to Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, and Employee Development while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

We are hiring   two Production Managers   to support either our   Front Half   or   Back Half   production teams. These roles support a compressed workweek schedule covering Days and Nights (Sunday-Wednesday or Wednesday-Saturday).

Join Analog Devices and help drive manufacturing excellence while advancing technologies that innovate ahead of   what's   possible.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

- Lead daily manufacturing operations for assigned shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost   objectives .

- Provide leadership, direction, and support to a team of 6-8 Production Supervisors overseeing   approximately   1 20   – 150   operators   between two shifts .

- Lead workforce growth initiatives, including recruiting, onboarding, and developing new manufacturing talent, with the potential to expand the   operator   workforce by potentially 40   additional   employees as the site continues to grow.

- Execute production plans and staffing strategies to meet customer demand while   maintaining   operational stability.

- Monitor manufacturing performance through operational metrics, dashboards, and visual management systems to drive   timely   decision-making and issue resolution.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain teams   and leaders   to resolve operational challenges and improve manufacturing performance.

- Support the introduction of new products, process changes, and manufacturing technologies while ensuring operational readiness and stable execution.

- Champion the adoption of digital manufacturing tools, automation solutions, and data-driven decision-making throughout the production organization.

Operational Excellence

- Promote a safe and healthy workplace by enforcing cleanroom protocols, 5S   S tandards, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

- Drive quality performance through disciplined problem-solving methodologies, including 8D, 5 Why s , Statistical Process Control (SPC), and root cause analysis.

- Monitor and improve key performance indicators including cycle time, productivity, labor efficiency, throughput, and schedule attainment.

- Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance productivity, reduce waste, and strengthen overall manufacturing performance.

- Partner in capacity planning and resource allocation activities to maximize throughput and operational flexibility.

- Support internal and external audits, inspections, and compliance activities while   maintaining   adherence to manufacturing and quality standards.

- Utilize manufacturing systems, analytics, and operational data to   identify   trends and drive sustainable performance improvements.

People Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop Production Supervisors while fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.

- Conduct performance management, succession planning, and talent development activities to strengthen organizational capability.

- Support recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training initiatives to ensure workforce readiness and operational success.

- Develop cross-training and skill-building programs that enhance workforce flexibility and employee growth.

- Drive effective communication across shifts and departments through daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, team meetings, and employee communications.

- Model and promote ADI's Enterprise Excellence Guiding Principles through visible leadership and operational discipline.

Schedule

This is an exempt leadership position supporting a 24/7 continuous semiconductor manufacturing operation at the Camas , WA   Wafer Fab.

Production Managers are assigned responsibility for either the   Front Half   or   Back Half   of the production week and   generally work   a compressed schedule of:

- Sunday-Wednesday

Or

- Wednesday-Saturday

Shift hours will be   determined   based on business needs and   assignment .

Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years of leadership experience in semiconductor manufacturing, wafer fabrication, cleanroom operations, or a comparable advanced manufacturing environment.

- Demonstrated success leading supervisors and large frontline manufacturing teams in a high-volume production environment.

- Previous   management experience in a semiconductor wafer fabrication facility.

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, production planning, quality systems, and continuous improvement methodologies.

- Experience   utilizing   manufacturing systems such as MES, ERP/MRP platforms, production scheduling, dispatching systems, and Microsoft Office applications.

- Proven ability to   leverage   operational data and analytics to improve performance and drive business results.

- Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.

- Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while balancing safety, quality, delivery, and cost   objectives .

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering , Manufacturing, Operations Management, or   related technical discipline.

- Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other Continuous Improvement certification.

- Experience supporting automation initiatives, digital manufacturing systems, and Industry 4.0 technologies.

- Experience leading operations within a 24/7 manufacturing environment.

Senior Program Manager- ESG, Data & Modeling

About the Role
The Senior ESG Program Manager supports and advances key ESG programs at ADI by translating regulatory requirements, customer expectations, and internal priorities into structured, repeatable processes and deliverables. This role leads and coordinates complex cross-functional work across areas such as product carbon foot printing, Scope 3 reporting support, target modeling, audits, and regulatory compliance activities. The person in this role uses sound judgment to manage multiple priorities, interpret evolving requirements, and drive progress across stakeholders while maintaining strong attention to detail and execution discipline. This role reports to the Head of ESG & Human Rights and works closely with teams across the business to help operationalize ADI’s ESG commitments.

Key Responsibilities
- Product Carbon Footprint Leadership : Lead ADI’s product carbon footprint work, including maintaining and improving the model, coordinating inputs across functions, and aligning outputs to external expectations such as ISO standards and customer requirements.
- Cross-Functional Program Execution : Coordinate ESG and sustainability initiatives across multiple other internal functions to support timely, effective execution of program requirements.
- Scope 3 and Reporting : Support Scope 3 reporting with multiple stakeholders, ensuring consistency, quality, and readiness of deliverables.
- Modeling and Forecasting: Lead or support efforts to model sustainability targets, including potential outcomes, impacts, and opportunities.
- Audit and Assessment Coordination : Support audits and assessments, including  RBA, ISO, and other efforts, including preparation guidance, documentation, and direct support with auditors.
- Customer Engagement : Manage customer engagements for PCF and other related topics, ensuring information provided is accurate and defendable.
- Process and Documentation Development : Develop and maintain procedures, work instructions, trackers, and other documentation that strengthen repeatability, clarity, and program operationalization.
- Project and Priority Management : Manage project timelines, action items, and competing priorities across multiple workstreams, escalating risks and gaps as needed to support program delivery.

Must Have Skills
- GHG Accounting Expertise : Direct experience with greenhouse gas accounting, including working knowledge of the GHG Protocol and its practical application in a business setting.
- Program Management : Experience managing multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously, with strong attention to timelines, dependencies, and deliverable quality.
- Regulatory and Compliance Interpretation : Ability to interpret environmental, sustainability, or compliance-related requirements and translate them into practical processes, actions, and documentation.
- Audit and Assessment Support : Experience supporting audits, assessments, certifications, or compliance programs, including evidence collection, documentation review, and follow-through.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration : Strong ability to work across functions, build alignment, and coordinate contributors in a matrixed environment.
- Written Communication and Documentation : Ability to create clear procedures, work instructions, trackers, and presentation materials for a range of internal and external audiences.
- Judgment and Execution Discipline : Demonstrated ability to manage detail-heavy work, balance competing priorities, and identify when issues or risks should be elevated.

Preferred Education and Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, sustainability, engineering, supply chain, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and 4+ years of related experience.
- 4–8 years of relevant experience in sustainability, ESG, environmental compliance, supply chain compliance, program management, or related field.
- Experience with product carbon foot printing, Scope 3 reporting, supplier engagement, or ESG reporting processes.
- Familiarity with RBA audits, customer sustainability requests, or global environmental compliance expectations.
- Experience working in a cross-functional, operational, or manufacturing-oriented environment.
- Preference for candidates local to Analog Devices headquarters in Wilmington, Massachusetts, though strong remote candidates will also be considered. No relocation is available for this position.
